caption:
The rules suddenly feel loose. You kept them for years and now they feel hollow — but what if that emptiness means you've reached where they were leading? (Galatians 4:1-3 devotional)

The heir is no different from a slave until the father's set day — and the law was a guardian leading us to Christ, a channel whose end is a face. God didn't abolish the command; He changed the motive, turning a servant's fear into a son's love. Same obedience, opposite hearts — so meet the Face the rules were pointing to.
